display.purpose: Page titles and section anchors. Tight tracking, balanced wrap.

body.purpose: Paragraphs, descriptions, form help, UI labels.

mono.purpose: Data and measurement only: timestamps, counts, IDs, handles, variables, shortcuts.

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: Modals and confirm dialogs only. The 1px ink ring preserves monochrome discipline in elevation.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Default easing for entrance and state transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink-filled primary action. Inverts to canvas on active.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; height:36px; padding:0 14px; background:#000; color:#fff; border:1px solid #000; border-radius:2px; font-family:Archivo,sans-serif; font-size:14px; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; transition:background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#1a1a1a; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background:#fff; color:#000; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #000; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; height:36px; padding:0 14px; background:#fff; color:#000; border:1px solid #000; border-radius:2px; font-family:Archivo,sans-serif; font-size:14px; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; transition:background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:#f5f5f5; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #000; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text field. Hairline border at rest, ink on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { display:block; width:100%; height:36px; padding:0 12px; background:#fff; color:#000; border:1px solid #dcdcdc; border-radius:2px; font-family:Archivo,sans-serif; font-size:14px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#767676; } .ds-input:focus { border-color:#000; outline:2px solid #000; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip / Tag
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; padding:2px 8px; background:#fff; color:#555; border:1px solid #dcdcdc; border-radius:2px; font-family:Archivo,sans-serif; font-size:12px; } .ds-chip-active { background:#000; color:#fff; border-color:#000; }

components.name: Nav Item (active)
components.description: Sidebar navigation item in active state — inverted to ink.
components.html: HomeMy LibraryExplore
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:2px; } .ds-nav-item { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; height:34px; padding:0 10px; color:#555; border-radius:2px; font-family:Archivo,sans-serif; font-size:14px; text-decoration:none; transition:background 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background:#f5f5f5; color:#000; } .ds-nav-active, .ds-nav-active:hover { background:#000; color:#fff; }

components.name: Dot-Matrix Wordmark
components.description: Signature dot-matrix logo mark built from a CSS radial-gradient grid — the grammar of the whole system.
components.css: .ds-dotmark { display:inline-block; width:24px; height:24px; background-image: radial-gradient(circle, #000 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 5px 5px; }

components.name: Variable Chip (fill preview)
components.description: Filled slot renders as an inverted ink block; empty slot stays dashed. Signature of the fill workspace.
components.css: .ds-var-filled { background:#000; color:#fff; padding:1px 3px; font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:13.5px; } .ds-var-empty { border:1px dashed #000; color:#555; padding:1px 3px; font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:13.5px; }

narrative.overview:
Prompt Labs is a working tool, not a showcase. Its personality is disciplined monochrome utility: pure white ground, black ink, hairline structure, and a dot-matrix vocabulary borrowed from dot-matrix printing and Nothing's dot-matrix design language. The aesthetic refuses the category default of colorful AI-dashboard card grids, gradient hero sheen, and chart decoration on a tool whose value is text.

Everything is built on a 4px rhythm with dense interior grouping and generous exterior separation. Corners are barely rounded (2px), borders are hairline, and shadows are essentially absent except for dialogs. The dot system is a parameterized primitive family — never wallpaper behind body text, inputs, or navigation labels.
keyCharacteristics: Strict monochrome, light-only; no hues, no gradients, no dark mode
Dot-matrix as grammar of structure, not decoration
Rows over cards; text over imagery
Three type voices: display grotesk, body sans, data mono

rules.name: The Monochrome Rule
rules.body: No hue enters the system. Emphasis comes from weight, size, or ink/canvas inversion — never color.

rules.name: The Line Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with 1px hairlines (#dcdcdc) and strong rules (1px #000000). Never thicker than 1px except the 2px focus ring.

rules.name: The Mono Rule
rules.body: Mono type is for data and measurement only — IDs, timestamps, counts, handles, variable placeholders, keyboard shortcuts, status codes. Never for headings, buttons, or body prose.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow at rest. Shadows appear only on dialogs — elements that must lift off the working surface to demand a decision.

dos: Do keep every surface pure monochrome — ink (#000000) on canvas (#ffffff) with ink-2 (#555555) and ink-3 (#767676) for secondary and muted text.
Do structure pages with hairline rules (1px #dcdcdc) and strong rules (1px #000000), not shadows or cards.
Do use IBM Plex Mono for data and measurement only: timestamps, counts, IDs, handles, variable names, shortcuts, backend status.
Do render the dot-matrix system as grammar — wordmark, empty states, loaders, status dots — never as wallpaper behind readable text.
Do invert to ink fill / canvas text for active nav items, filled variable chips, and selection.
Do maintain 2px radius on controls; hairline borders at rest.
Do theme browser surfaces: selection (ink/canvas), caret, focus rings (2px ink outline, 2px offset), scrollbars (line thumb on canvas track).
donts: Don't introduce any hue, gradient, or dark mode. The system is light-only and strictly monochrome.
Don't use monospace for headings, buttons, or body prose — it is a data voice, not a costume.
Don't build pages from same-size cards of icon + heading + text. Use rows and hairline-ruled lists.
Don't put a kicker or eyebrow above a heading. The heading carries its own weight.
Don't use hard offset shadows (box-shadow: 4px 4px 0) — the world is flat, not neobrutalist.
Don't place dot-matrix fields behind body text, inputs, or navigation labels.
Don't exceed 1px border width except the 2px focus ring.
Don't invent metrics, ratings, or social proof. Every number shown is a real count of the user's own data.
